answer_2.quote: We report the accuracy on both benchmarks. For the RL scenario, we evaluate our methods on the AlpacaEval2 and MT-Bench benchmarks. We provide results for AlpacaEval2 in terms of Length-controlled Win Rate (LC WR) and Win Rate (WR), and for MT-Bench, we report the overall score.
